votes.motion: Grant the Settlers Solar special permit only, with conditions per the draft Decision, adding Condition #20 and removing G. Bittner as signatory (amended motion).

votes.motion: Approve the Settlers Solar site plan approval as documented.
votes.quote: k. chenis made a motion to approve the site plan approval as documented, seconded by d. prokowiew, all aye.

votes.motion: Approve the five (5) Board warrant article amendments as documented and make minor changes on the town meeting floor.
votes.quote: k. chenis made motion to approve the five (5) article amendments as documented

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the 9/10/18 Executive Session.
votes.quote: k. chenis made motion to approve, d. prokowiew seconded, all aye.
